create_NASCell: create a NASCell recurrent network cell with configurable units and optional projection layer
build_NASCell_with_transforms: build a NASCell with input, state, and update transforms for variational dropout
run_NASCell_step: run one step of the NASCell recurrent network given inputs and previous state
configure_NASCell_biases: configure a NASCell with optional biases and custom variable initializer
review_NASCell_properties: review the NASCell state_size and output_size properties for LSTMStateTuple compatibility
